name: universal-file-router
description: Cross-platform file routing, instant folder creation, batch renaming, history, and system-wide undo for macOS & Windows.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

commands.name: universal-file-router
commands.title: Move Files
commands.description: Move, copy, or batch-rename currently selected files across macOS and Windows.

commands.name: undo
commands.title: Undo Last File Move
commands.description: Undo the last file move or copy operation.

commands.name: history
commands.title: File Move History
commands.description: View and undo recent file move and copy operations.

title: Universal File Router
author: robinwerner
